Sofia, I can't find a name for Kwame's night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor in anything you have access to.

- **What I checked:** #coastal-team, #coastal-random, #general, #help-it-ops, our DM, and the public files, including the Coastal cheat sheet.
- **What the cheat sheet says:** Driftmoor Marine Freight is one of the Coastal accounts. Engineering gave their night dispatcher a manual CSV patch for the failed tide-table import on Terminal B. It doesn't name the dispatcher or give an email address.
- **What I can't see:** Driftmoor's own account files aren't in the share you can read. I won't guess at a name or address.

Kwame is the person to ask for the contact's name and address. Check before you send, too. Mail to anyone outside pemberline.com, drafts included, needs Ruth Calloway's approval. Since the dispatcher is at a customer, that will almost certainly apply. Once you have the address, tell me and I'll ask Ruth for approval.
